tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue (#2e7ef6), kept exact for the mark, the 'On' power symbol and non-text fills (cover blocks, accents). Text labels never sit on it — white is only 3.9:1. Button fills use `brand-blue-strong`. Never small text — use `link`.

tokens.name: brand-blue-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, the nav CTA and the Oni button: the logo hue taken one step darker so `on-brand` white labels reach 5.0:1 at any size. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/active fill of brand buttons and the nav CTA, one step darker than `brand-blue-strong`; white text 5.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Logo navy. Dark brand surfaces: the Oni AI card, the skip link. White text 16.5:1.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Signal yellow. One accent per view: the hero highlight underline, the eyebrow dash. Never text on light grounds (1.6:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Blue TEXT: links, 'Cotizar ahora →' row links, hover color of accordion questions. ≥5.6:1 on every light surface, ≥5.3:1 on every dark one.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. On `brand-ink` panels use `on-brand` instead.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Base ink. Prefer the semantic alias `text-primary`.

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Base page ground. Prefer the semantic alias `bg-primary`.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Legacy primary; lifted in dark so old blue text keeps contrast. New work: `brand-blue` for fills, `link` for text.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Logo gray ('Seguros' in the wordmark). Decorative only — 2:1 on light grounds, never text.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg-primary`, `surface-*` and `surface-band` (≥17:1 light, ≥14:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, labels, nav links, eyebrows on `bg-primary`, `surface-*`, `surface-band`.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Fine print, testimonial roles, captions. ≥4.5:1 on every light surface; ≥4.8:1 on dark surfaces up to #292929.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Warm alternate section band: Services, Contact, the featured testimonial panel.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Deepest layer: newsletter strip, claim mini-card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating header/footer cards, focused inputs, testimonial avatars.

tokens.name: float-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of the floating header and footer cards.

tokens.name: float-watermark
tokens.usage: Footer wordmark, barely off the card. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-light
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card edges. Decorative separators only (not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-medium
tokens.usage: Input borders (2px), row rules in banded sections.

tokens.name: border-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary button border; hover goes to `text-primary`.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of blog search and newsletter inputs: ≥3:1 against the page in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Literal in blog.css (--blog-field-border).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairline under each row of an index (services, stats, accordion, contact).

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: 2px rule that OPENS a list or section index. One per list.

tokens.name: primary-lighter
tokens.usage: Derived blue tint; input focus halo (`primary-100`).

tokens.name: primary-300
tokens.usage: Legacy ladder; in dark 8.2:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: primary-400
tokens.usage: Legacy ladder; in dark 7.1:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: primary-500
tokens.usage: Legacy ladder alias of `color-primary` (old skip link, old hover colors).

tokens.name: primary-600
tokens.usage: Legacy ladder alias of `color-primary` (old skip link, old hover colors).

tokens.name: error-500
tokens.usage: Invalid input border after a submit attempt. Pair with a text message, never color alone.

tokens.name: error-600
tokens.usage: Error text and icons; ADMIN danger button fill (white 4.8:1) and its error toast bar.

tokens.name: error-700
tokens.usage: Darker red: ADMIN danger-button hover (white 6.5:1), logout hover text, the Siniestro category text.

tokens.name: success-500
tokens.usage: Success marks (newsletter confirmation). Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error messages (newsletter, forms) on `bg-primary`. Dark uses #f87171 because error-600 is only 4.1:1 on the dark page. Literal in blog.css.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success messages (newsletter confirmation) on `bg-primary`. Literal in blog.css.

tokens.name: success-rule
tokens.usage: 3px left rule beside a success message. Literal in blog.css.

tokens.name: claim-error
tokens.usage: Claim form (/siniestros/) error text, required asterisk and the error bar on invalid fields: 5.9:1 on white, 7.4:1 on the dark page. Literal in siniestros.css (--sin-error).

tokens.name: claim-success
tokens.usage: Claim form success border and heading (5.0:1 on white). Literal in siniestros.css (--sin-success).

tokens.name: claim-field-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of claim-form inputs and radio cards (≥3:1). Resolved from siniestros.css color-mix(text-primary 52%, transparent).

tokens.name: claim-placeholder
tokens.usage: Claim-form placeholders, just past AA (5.2:1 light, 5.3:1 dark) so they still read lighter than typed text. Resolved from siniestros.css color-mix().

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Testimonial ★ rating marks (≥3.5:1 graphic contrast on bg and band). Literal in style.css (.testimonial-card .star).

tokens.name: whatsapp-green
tokens.usage: WhatsApp FAB at rest (icon only, no text). Literal in style.css (.whatsapp-fab).

tokens.name: whatsapp-deep
tokens.usage: WhatsApp FAB expanded with its label; white text 4.9:1. Literal in style.css.

tokens.name: ua-blue
tokens.usage: Universal Assistance blue — ONLY inside the UA partner panel, always under UA's white negative logo (white 8:1). Never ours elsewhere.

tokens.name: chat-agent-bg
tokens.usage: Oni's chat bubbles (with a 1px `rule` edge). From agente.css.

tokens.name: chat-user-bg
tokens.usage: The client's chat bubbles, white text (16.5:1 light; dark lifts the navy so it reads on near-black). From agente.css.

tokens.name: chat-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of the Oni chat card. From agente.css.

tokens.name: admin-bg
tokens.usage: ADMIN page ground (--gray-50 in admin.css). Light-only: the admin has no dark mode, so this stays light in every theme.

tokens.name: admin-gray-100
tokens.usage: ADMIN (light-only): hover wash, slug chips, subnav track.

tokens.name: admin-gray-200
tokens.usage: ADMIN: borders of inputs, cards, header, nav.

tokens.name: admin-gray-400
tokens.usage: ADMIN: decorative only (toolbar dividers). Not for text or icons — 2.5:1 on white; placeholders and the toast close icon use `admin-gray-500`.

tokens.name: admin-gray-500
tokens.usage: ADMIN: meta lines, char counts, placeholders, toast close icon (4.6:1 on `admin-input-bg`, 4.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: admin-gray-600
tokens.usage: ADMIN: descriptions, nav buttons, user email (7.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: admin-gray-800
tokens.usage: ADMIN: headings and body ink (= color-text).

tokens.name: admin-error-light
tokens.usage: ADMIN: error toast icon wash, danger hover.

tokens.name: admin-primary-text
tokens.usage: ADMIN blue text and icons (hover titles, links, spinner, toolbar hover, info toast icon, FAQ badge): ≥4.7:1 on every admin surface. --primary-text in admin.css.

tokens.name: admin-success-text
tokens.usage: ADMIN green text: 'En vivo' preview badge, success toast and modal icons (4.6:1 on `admin-success-light`). --success-text in admin.css.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: ADMIN draft badge 'Pendiente IA' text on `status-pending-bg` (6.0:1).

families.sans: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Landing hero h1. Fluid: clamp(2.375rem, 1.4rem + 4.6vw, 4.75rem). One highlighted phrase underlined in `color-accent`.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 (Por qué elegirnos, Servicios, Testimonios, Contacto). Fluid: clamp(1.875rem, 1.25rem + 2.4vw, 2.75rem); text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Figures in the stats strip (+25, +8, 24/7). Fluid from 2.25rem.

styles.name: travel-title
styles.usage: Partner/feature block title. Fluid from 1.75rem.
styles.sample: Con Universal Assistance y OnSeguros viajás protegido

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Service row titles (line-height inherited from body).

styles.name: quote-featured
styles.usage: The one featured testimonial quote. Fluid from 1.25rem.
styles.sample: Cuando necesitás ayuda de verdad, ahí está.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Hero index lines (01 Seguros Agrícolas) and other ruled list rows (line-height inherited from body).

styles.name: accordion-question
styles.usage: FAQ / legal accordion questions.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero description in `text-secondary`. Fluid: clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.375rem).
styles.sample: Protegemos tus cosechas, tu empresa y tu patrimonio.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: About description, contact values.
styles.sample: Más de 25 años de experiencia en Río Cuarto y zona.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy (body line-height 1.6). Descriptions take 1.625.
styles.sample: Trabajamos con compañías líderes y brindamos asesoramiento directo.

styles.name: button-brand
styles.usage: Labels on `brand-blue` buttons and the nav CTA (19px bold = WCAG large text). Secondary buttons share it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, nav-adjacent UI text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary details, testimonial roles, newsletter description.

styles.name: fineprint
styles.usage: Disclaimers and conditions under CTAs, in `text-secondary`.
styles.sample: Coberturas sujetas a condiciones del producto contratado.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE, letter-spacing 0.08em, `text-secondary`. Hero badge and contact labels (0.06em). Preceded by a 2rem × 2px `accent-dark` dash in the hero.
styles.sample: 25 AÑOS PROTEGIENDO LO QUE MÁS IMPORTA

styles.name: blog-title
styles.usage: Blog listing h1. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 1.6rem + 4vw, 4.5rem).

styles.name: post-title
styles.usage: Post h1, under the 2px rule and the eyebrow date. Fluid from 2rem.

styles.name: blog-card-title
styles.usage: Post rows in the listing; the newest post leads at clamp(1.5rem … 2.125rem).

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.usage: h2 inside a post (h3 1.25rem, h4 1.125rem).

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Post body copy in `text-primary`; paragraphs `space-lg` apart.
styles.sample: El granizo puede arruinar una campaña en minutos.

styles.name: chat-bubble
styles.usage: Oni chat messages (0.9rem under 640px).
styles.sample: ¿Qué tipo de seguro necesitás cotizar hoy?

styles.name: admin-section-title
styles.usage: ADMIN section h2, with a 60×3px `color-accent` underline.

styles.name: admin-item-title
styles.usage: ADMIN post/FAQ list item titles.

styles.name: admin-label
styles.usage: ADMIN form labels (Space Grotesk).

styles.name: admin-body
styles.usage: ADMIN inputs, descriptions and buttons (15px).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: ADMIN status badges: uppercase, 0.04em.

styles.name: faq-title
styles.usage: FAQ page h1. Fluid: clamp(2.125rem, 1.4rem + 3vw, 3.5rem).

styles.name: claim-title
styles.usage: Claim form h1. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 2.6vw, 3rem).

styles.name: claim-section-title
styles.usage: Numbered claim-form section titles (01 Tus datos).

styles.name: admin-preview-title
styles.usage: ADMIN live-preview article title.

styles.name: admin-preview-body
styles.usage: ADMIN live-preview body in `admin-gray-700`.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: 8px. Button icon gap, label-to-input gap, mobile float inset.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: 16px. Input padding, mobile page gutter, row padding in lists.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: 24px. Row padding (accordion, stats, contact), form-group spacing, tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: 32px. Button horizontal padding, desktop gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: 40px. Service-row vertical padding on desktop, featured quote padding.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: 64px. Column gap in split headers; FAQ list bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: 80px. Section top/bottom padding on the landing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chat bubble 'tail' corner (agent top-left, user top-right).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 4px. Focus-outline rounding on links and accordion questions.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 8px. Brand buttons, inputs, nav CTA, Oni card, featured quote panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars (testimonial initials, Oni avatar).

tokens.name: float-shadow
tokens.usage: The one soft neutral shadow of the floating header/footer cards and the travel card.

tokens.name: float-shadow-scrolled
tokens.usage: Header card once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: effect-raised
tokens.usage: Top highlight + shadow for raised legacy cards (claim mini-card outside the landing).

tokens.name: btn-shadow
tokens.usage: Legacy button depth. Brand buttons (`.btn--primary/secondary`) are flat: box-shadow none.

tokens.name: effect-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Legacy card hover; admin list items and secondary buttons on hover.

tokens.name: highlight-top
tokens.usage: Legacy top-edge light on raised elements.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: lg breakpoint; nav collapses to a menu below it.

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Page column (.container max-width) and floating header max width.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header card inner height; 76px from 1024px up.

tokens.name: float-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between floating cards and the viewport edge (= space-sm; space-md from 640px).

tokens.name: float-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the floating cards (= space-md; space-lg ≥640px, space-xl ≥1024px).

tokens.name: fab-offset
tokens.usage: FAB distance from the bottom-right corner (= space-xl; space-lg ≤768px).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: min-height of buttons and inputs (WCAG). Nav links and toggles use 44px. Literal in style.css.
